data.name: Asala
data.gender_notes: Asala is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Asala means 'healer' or 'repentant'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 's-l-h', which connotes healing, restoration, and turning back to God. In Islamic tradition, it is said that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) named a female camel Asala due to its healing properties. Thus, this name carries a deep spiritual significance, reminding us of the importance of seeking forgiveness and restoration in our relationship with Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the importance of seeking forgiveness and restoration in our relationship with Allah.
data.etymology: Asala belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healer, Repentant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asala total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name 'Asala' carries a deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of the importance of seeking forgiveness and restoration in our relationship with Allah. Thus, this name is a powerful reminder of the endless mercy and compassion of Allah and the importance of striving to maintain a strong bond with Him.
